notes: 375x812 touch phone (hasTouch, isMobile, pointer:coarse, hover:none), prefers-color-scheme light. The app loaded dark on every seed/reload; switching to light with the top-bar theme button was done as setup and is not counted. The `clicks` field counts TAPS (locator.tap()); picking an option in a native <select> counts as one tap after the tap that opens it. Scrolling (swipes, done with scrollIntoViewIfNeeded) is not counted as a tap. Typing was pressSequentially into the focused field; keystrokes = characters typed. Screenshot paths are under S/walk/w2-touch/ where S is the session scratchpad.
